_README: Copy the block for your provider into config.json. provider is optional (auto-detected from model name: claude*->anthropic, gemini*->gemini, else openai). base_url is optional (uses the provider default). max_tokens is optional (default 400).

_example_openrouter_free_rotation._note: OpenRouter with FREE-model rotation. Jarvis tries models in order; on a rate-limit/provider error it moves to the next. Get a key at openrouter.ai. Browse the live free list at https://openrouter.ai/models?max_price=0 — these slugs were verified working; swap/add any ':free' model.

_example_9router_local_gateway._note: 9Router is a SELF-HOSTED local gateway (npm/Docker) that routes to 40+ providers. It runs on YOUR machine at http://localhost:20128/v1 (OpenAI-compatible). Get your API key + model/combo name from its dashboard at http://localhost:20128/dashboard. Jarvis's server.py must run on the SAME machine as 9Router for this to work.
